headline: Saipem Shares Surge on Strong Q3 Results and 2027 Guidance
summary: Saipem shares surged following the release of strong third-quarter financial results and reaffirmed financial guidance through 2027.
why: Saipem is a global oilfield services and engineering contractor whose earnings provide key insights into offshore energy capital expenditure trends.

impacts.name: Saipem
impacts.why: The company reported strong third-quarter earnings and positive 2027 guidance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong third-quarter financial performance and upbeat forward guidance for 2027 drove heavy buying in Saipem shares.
